id.description: Stable card ID, independent of the folder or translated name.

name.description: English card name. The German name goes in data.de.json.

deckLimitKey.description: Shared copy-limit identity. Usually the card ID; reprints can share this key.

factions.description: Use named factions, ["neutral"], or [] for a neutral card. Neutral cannot be combined with a named faction.

subtypes.description: Freeform subtypes, e.g. human, elf, leader or unicorn. They are not a closed enum; German labels live in the shared dictionary (packages/ui/src/i18n/de.json), not per card.

legendary.description: One copy per deck and collection, regardless of rarity.

rarity.description: Booster rarity; independent of the legendary copy-limit flag.

factions.description: Faction-specific costs. neutral, generic and primal are not valid cost keys.

lore.description: Optional flavor text. Rules text comes from the registered ability descriptions.

abilities.description: Registered abilities. Parameters depend on the selected ID.

energyOutputs.description: Alternative printed production pools: choose one when channeling or receiving response energy. One pool with several keys produces all of them. [] means no printed production; Primal is an ability.

cast.description: Spell operations resolved in list order.

modal.description: Choose one: the caster picks a single entry of cast when playing the spell, so cast needs at least two entries. Without it every entry resolves in list order.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference; ignored by the game importer.

title: Realms of Varhyr card
description: An authored assets/cards/<card-name>/data.json definition. Artwork comes from data.png; animation optionally comes from data.webm.
$comment: Generated by npm run schema:cards and card imports. Edit the Valibot definitions, factions, sets or abilities instead.

ability-accord.description: After you cast your first spell each turn during your play phase, gain 1 Northern League energy.

ability-armor.title: Armor {amount}
ability-armor.description: Damage dealt to this card is reduced by {amount}.

ability-banner.title: Banner {amount}
ability-banner.description: Adjacent friendly creatures and holdings get +{amount} Attack.

ability-barrage.description: Deal {amount} damage to each enemy creature.

ability-bolster.description: Each friendly creature gets {?attack|+{attack} Attack|}{?attack&defense| and |}{?defense|+{defense} Defense|} until end of turn.

ability-bounce.description: Return target {target} creature to its owner's hand.

ability-charge.description: When played, deal {amount} damage to the opposite enemy creature.

ability-consume.description: Additional cost: sacrifice a friendly creature with an energy cost of {amount} or more.

ability-covert.title: Covert
ability-covert.description: This creature can't be blocked. Its attack always hits the opposing player.

ability-damage.description: Deal {amount} damage to target enemy creature, holding or player.

ability-dark-harvest.description: Exhaust: put the top card of your library into your discard pile and gain 2 Host energy. Requires at least 2 cards in your library.

ability-dirge.description: Each friendly creature gets +1 {stat} for each {cards} card in your discard pile.

ability-fealty.description: All friendly creatures, including this one, get +1 Attack and +1 Defense.

ability-guard.title: Guard
ability-guard.description: Blocks attacks aimed at adjacent lanes, even empty ones. Stops one attacker per combat.

ability-hive.description: Whenever a friendly {subtype} creature dies, {?first|put the topmost {subtype} creature from your library into your hand.|search your library for one {subtype} creature and put it into your hand.}

ability-kindle.description: Whenever you cast {?subtype|a {subtype} spell|a spell}, deal {amount} damage to target enemy creature, holding or player.

ability-longshot.description: Exhaust: deal {amount} damage to target enemy creature.

ability-marches-rally.description: Exhaust: deploy a creature or holding from your hand to a free position without paying its cost. It enters exhausted.

ability-muster.description: Search your library for all copies of {card} and put them into your hand.

ability-outflank.title: Outflank {amount}
ability-outflank.description: While on a flank, this creature gets +{amount} Attack.

ability-primal.description: Exhaust: gain {amount} energy of a faction of your choice.

ability-prowess.description: This creature gets {?attack|+{attack} Attack|}{?attack&defense| and |}{?defense|+{defense} Defense|} for each spell you cast this turn.

ability-quickened.title: Quickened
ability-quickened.description: Enters ready: it can attack or channel energy the turn it is played.

ability-rage.description: Target friendly creature gets +{amount} Attack until end of turn.

ability-raid.description: This card has +1 Attack for each adjacent friendly creature.

ability-raise.description: Return one {subtype} creature from your discard pile to a free position. It enters ready.

ability-ransack.description: Look at your opponent's hand. They discard a card of your choice.

ability-reprise.description: When played, cast a spell from your discard pile without paying its cost.

ability-return.description: Additional cost: return a friendly creature to its owner's hand.

ability-sacrifice.description: Sacrifice another friendly creature: gain {amount} energy of each of its types.

ability-scorch.description: When played, deal {amount} damage to target enemy creature opposite or in an adjacent lane, or to the enemy player.

ability-searchForCreatureOrHolding.description: {?first|Put the topmost creature or holding with an energy cost of {maxCost} or less from your library into your hand.|Search your library for a creature or holding with an energy cost of {maxCost} or less and put it into your hand.}

ability-shield-wall.title: Shield Wall {amount}
ability-shield-wall.description: Adjacent friendly creatures and holdings get +{amount} Defense.

ability-steadfast.description: Target friendly creature gets +{amount} Defense until end of turn.

ability-trade.description: When this creature channels during your play phase, it also produces 1 neutral energy.

ability-wayfarer.description: Exhaust: return a friendly creature, including this one, to its owner’s hand.

ability-weaken.description: The opposite enemy creature or holding gets -{amount} Attack.

subtypes.description: A spell has at most one subtype: strike (damage to one target), barrage (damage to every enemy creature), tactic (combat bonus), rite (healing, reanimation, drawing), curse (destroys outright), divination (finding things).
